target.command:
cd /home/john/mynotes/deterministic_equidistribution_theory/c_suite
make 2>&1 | grep -iE "error|warning"; echo built
./collatz_tests fourier-compare --moduli 9,27,81,243 --char-cap 4 --bmax 24 --output-dir out_large 2>&1 | tail -1
echo "=== residue-only gaps (all should be <=1 by Wielandt = reliable) ==="
grep -v '^#' out_large/fourier_comparison.csv | grep -v '^Q,' | awk -F, '{printf "Q=%-3s k=%s xi=%.4f ann|p^|=%.4f  gap_s0=%.4f  gap_s1=%.4f\n",$1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6}'
echo "--- any gap_ratio > 1 (would signal nonconvergence)? ---"
grep -v '^#' out_large/fourier_comparison.csv | grep -v '^Q,' | awk -F, '$5>1.0001||$6>1.0001{print "  >1:",$0}' | head; echo "(none above = good)"
